messages:
maria: Pushed a lightweight observability board to Grafana — 'cache observability sketch' shows hit-rate by model, route, tenant and a token-saved waterfall. Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd

devon: Nice — which sampling window? I only see 5m by default.

maria: Default is 15m; can change in upper-right. Observed oddity: /chat-stream route for model-neo-13b has hit-rate ~12% but token-saved is much lower than other routes with similar traffic.

sara: Could be key-normalization differences. We shipped prompt-normalize last week; some customers still send trailing whitespace + noise (UUIDs). Logs show repeated distinct keys: `prompt_key=sha256("order: 12345\\n")` vs `sha256("order: 12345")`.

devon: Ah — classic key-entropy leak. Can we add a 'normalized_key' column to the board and a small histogram of key-length / unique-keys per tenant? That will show which tenants have high key cardinality.

maria: Will add that. Also noticed a kernel-switch correlation: when runtime falls back from fused-attn to fallback kernel under long-context, batching efficiency drops and cache warmup suffers — warmup latency spike lines up with lower hit-rate.

sara: Do you have a trace? I can annotate the dashboard with traces. Example trace: `trace_id=0x7a3b` shows repeated cache misses and KV eviction churn at t=12s.

maria: Posted the trace link in the panel. Quick config snapshot I used for reproduction: ```yaml
cache:
  key_fn: sha256(normalize(prompt))
  ttl_seconds: 300
  max_entries_per_tenant: 50000
``` 

devon: A couple of suggestions: 1) add per-tenant 'cold_hit_rate' gauge and a ratio tokens_saved/tokens_generated. 2) alert if tokens_saved/1m drops >50% vs rolling-7d baseline. 3) for /chat-stream, try sampling-based prefetch and an adaptive per-route batch size so kernel transitions don't kill batching.

ops-bot: deploy:cache-obsv-panel v1.1 -> success :white_check_mark:

sara: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with a short runbook describing the normalization fixes vs eviction tuning and add recommended queries for tenant ops.

maria: Thanks — assigned owner @sara for the normalization audit. Leaving the dashboard open for 24h heatmap collection; will re-run profiling and post notes.
